verdict.summary: Round 1's major fail-closed parsing defect is fixed. parse_request now distinguishes an absent source key from every present non-string value, defaults only the absent case to the body lane, and returns BAD_REQUEST for null, boolean, numeric, array, and object values. The focused regression test supplies otherwise-valid datasets, so it would exercise the former type-confusion path rather than pass vacuously. The stateful server-store path remains generation-keyed, refuses ambiguous body/server selection and unsupported ODRL/trust combinations, and its integration tests exercise the real HTTP and store-update paths. No remaining correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the supplied diff.
